# fal.ai Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill for fal.ai's serverless media generation: run hundreds of models (FLUX, Ideogram, Veo, Kling, Luma, Whisper, music models…) behind one API key, submit/poll/fetch jobs, and upload input files. Honest note: there is NO free tier for inference — every successful run spends your prepaid balance, so the skill confirms cost-appropriate choices and failed jobs don't charge you. Honest limits: generated files come back as expiring URLs — download them before they vanish.
